---
title: "Global Economic Interactivity"
---

Adjust the country code to dynamically pull real-time GDP data straight from the World Bank API:

```{ojs}
// 1. Create a reactive UI dropdown
viewof country = Inputs.select(["US", "GB", "CN", "DE", "FR"], {value: "GB", label: "Select Country:"})

// 2. Fetch directly from the public API based on the selection
gdpData = fetch(`https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/${country}/indicator/NY.GDP.MKTP.CD?format=json&per_page=50`)
  .then(response => response.json())
  .then(data => data[1].filter(d => d.value !== null))

// 3. Render the interactive line chart dynamically
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(gdpData, {x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "steelblue"}),
    Plot.dot(gdpData, {x: "date", y: "value", fill: "red"})
  ],
  y: { label: "GDP (Current USD)" },
  x: { tickFormat: "" }
})
```
